TUN.note: The decree-law defines the interoperability platform and names the CNI to set up and run it; it does not say a platform is built, piloted or live.

systems.system: Registre de l'identifiant unique du citoyen

TUN.note: Article 9 requires interoperability to use the citizen unique identifier register to identify persons; it is a legal requirement with no system stated as in use or being built.
